items.title: Royalty Pharma acquires royalty interest in AstraZeneca’s cliramitug for up to $425 million from Neurimmune
items.summary: NEW YORK, NY, July 22, 2026 — Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) today announced that it has acquired a portion of Neurimmune’s royalty interest in AstraZeneca’s cliramitug for up to $425 million, including $125 million upfront.

items.title: Royalty Pharma to announce second quarter 2026 financial results on August 5, 2026
items.summary: NEW YORK, NY, July 15, 2026 — Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) today announced that it will report its second quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, August 5, 2026 before the U.S. financial markets open. The company will host a conference call and simultaneous webcast at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time that day.

items.summary: NEW YORK, NY, March 30, 2026 - Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) today announced a research and development (R&D) co-funding agreement with Johnson & Johnson for a total of $500 million in 2026 and 2027 to advance the development of JNJ-4804, an investigational medicine for autoimmune diseases.

items.title: Royalty Pharma Appoints Lucas Glass as Head of Artificial Intelligence
items.summary: NEW YORK, NY, March 23, 2026 – Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) today announced the appointment of Lucas Glass as Head of Artificial Intelligence, effective April 2026. Lucas will lead the development and implementation of artificial intelligence capabilities across Royalty Pharma.
